column1: # rules.tsv: every forge-kit rule that has ONE home, read by scripts/check-rules.sh.
#   id       the rule id, as in the `<!-- rule: <id> v<N> -->` comment beside the canonical text
#   home     the one file holding the rule text (tracked, repo-relative)
#   pointers space-separated files that must name the rule by its id comment instead of restating it
#   anchors  `|`-separated phrases of the rule text that may appear under plugins/ only in the home
# A new rule is one row here plus its id comment in the home: no new guard, no new test suite.
# An id retired for good (rows in retired-rules.tsv, no home) has no row here.
